steps.title: Start with a board, a piece and a panel
steps.instruction: Join a board, a piece and a panel (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A board, a piece and a panel are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the FALHOLMEN table. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 128 cm), B (piece, about 116 cm), C (panel, about 60 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 60 cm tall.

steps.title: Add a panel
steps.instruction: Attach a panel (D) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
